statBlock.name: Cloud Giant
statBlock.classification: Huge giant, neutral good (50%) or neutral evil (50%)
statBlock.description: Cloud giants live in mountain castles and on solid clouds. Treasure, beautiful works of art, and lavish gifts earn them standing among their kin.

sections.Traits: Keen Smell. The giant has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on scent.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma. The giant needs no material components for these spells. For a spell that calls for a save, use DC 15, calculated from Charisma +3 and proficiency +4.
At will. Detect Magic, Fog Cloud, Light.
3/day each. Feather Fall, Fly, Misty Step, Telekinesis.
1/day each. Control Weather, Gaseous Form.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Morningstar attacks.
Morningstar. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 151 and 154. The official errata corrects the Constitution saving throw to +10.

statBlock.name: Hill Giant
statBlock.description: Hill giants roam hills and valleys looking for food. They raid farms and press smaller creatures into feeding them.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatclub attacks.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

statBlock.name: Stone Giant
statBlock.description: Stone giants carve their secluded caverns into settlements. They prize skilled sculptors and judge rock throwing by grace as well as strength.

sections.Traits: Stone Camouflage. When hiding in rocky terrain, the giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatclub attacks.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. On a hit, a creature must make a DC 17 Strength save or fall Prone.
sections.Reactions: Rock Catching. When someone throws a rock or similar object at the giant, it can attempt a DC 10 Dexterity save as a reaction. On a success, it catches the object and takes no bludgeoning damage from it.
